text: Not exactly the same situation but I personally witnessed people who already passed the immigration and were called back to be returned to the airport they came from because they came on a pilgrimage tour as a group and 2 of the members where denied for a reason that they may illegally stay, so those others who were already allowed to enter where again called back to be denied entry. My point is, in the immigration, they can change their decision in a matter of minutes just like what happened to your family.
